# Load packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
```

# Load dataset

```{r}
df <- read.csv("data/processed/student_politics_final.csv")
```

# Construct survival variables

```{r}
df$time <- ifelse(df$MP == 1,
                  df$year_parliament - df$year_student_pol,
                  2026 - df$year_student_pol)

df$event <- df$MP
```

# Run main cox model

```{r}
model1 <- glm(MP ~ association + gender + cohort + ticket_position,
              data = df,
              family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(model1)
```

# Hazard ratios

```{r}
exp(coef(cox_model))
```
